Favor ASGR and NINE for their scalable digital infrastructure and fintech exposure, but trim KREN and CENT on valuation froth. Maintain WATCH for a pullback to add; the US +0.72% lag confirms domestic catalysts dominate.

Rotate into mid-cap FMCG with volume growth and margin recovery; avoid laggards lacking pricing power. Position for continued strength into Q3 earnings season.
